run_split_json_cli: run split_json.py to split loose JSON data files into train dev and test splits
run_get_lines: run get_lines to read and strip all lines from a JSON data file
run_get_splits: run get_splits to shuffle and partition lines into train dev and test subsets
run_format_mappings: run format_mappings to create tab-separated file and line index mapping entries
run_write_files: run write_files to write split data and mapping files to the output directory
